This local security-corrected source build is NOT an unmodified upstream binary.
Only AuthSdkActivity result callback custody is corrected; public APIs, real strategy
contracts, native package signatures, SSL handlers and result validation stay upstream.
Manifest package attribute is moved to AGP namespace only. See provenance.json.
No bearer is removed from a saved Bundle after the fact: the real callback consumes
it at STOP. Full inherited saved-state behavior remains enabled and is tested.
